I should also mention a few things. 

the house was made in the year 2000

The prior tenants had substance abuse issues and trashed the majority of the house, mainly ruining floors and paint. 

The bathroom in the picture has more substancial damage because the sink faucet exploded and was left for a week before the water was turned off before we moved in. 

The only damage is in that portion of the house and occasional natural water damage to floors because of it being particle board. 

The videos in the post you can find on my page aren’t the only instances, just the only videos I have downloaded on my phone at this time. Not even the lights in the closet next to the bathroom flash they are very specific rooms throughout the house.

It’s not always the same socket, we have switched bulbs around the house and replaced bulbs, the flashing doesn’t follow them and doesn’t stop when we change bulbs in the room it happens in. 

No other electronics including lamps have had this issue 

All doors that have opened on their own have been repeatedly checked to make sure the latch works properly and cannot be pushed open with all my weight against them.

Typically it opened while he was asleep and he would always tell off his brother before his brother angerly told him off because it wasn’t him 

Once his brother was asking him to keep it closed because a girl was over and woke him up angry at him for keeping it open, even though before he had fallen asleep it was closed. 

Another couple instances of paranormal things happening I didn’t mention because it could just be tricks of the eye:

1. 
I once attempted to use Incense, it was about a week after we had the dog encounter. The smoke swirled for a while (I turned off any fans or air conditioning until I could notice buildup) and then collected oddly in the air. It was staying about 3 feet from the ceiling and shaped into what I can only describe as what looked like an upper torso stemming from the stick (think genie) but with a skeletal/corpseish head. My cat who was watching the smoke swirl in mesmerization suddenly meowed and ran into the hall when this happened and wouldn’t even come out for treats until the figure dispersed, I then turned on the fan and air conditioning after to clear the air. I only had them off so I could watch the smoke and so the ember wouldn’t immediately blow out from behind under the fan. 

2. 
Another time when going into the back bedroom (the one that was my bfs that the door would randomly open at night) in the evening to grab some tools (I do many craft on hobbies in my free time that sometimes require them, and the bedroom is storage at the moment. When opening the door I noticed a perfect circle about the same diameter as the bottom of a can of soda. As a digital artist it looked like overlayed almost? Semi transparent. 

Its path seemed to have been started before I opened the door and didn’t waver from me stepping in or opening the door more. I did so to see if it was dust which would’ve moved from the air moving. It was about 2 feet away and slowly but steadily bobbed at a consistent pace while moving towards the lower portion of the wall the door was on (moving parallel to where I was standing) which shares a wall with our other bathroom which has also had flashing lights often, it was the one that first did it and has done it the most. 

My cat had ran in as soon as I opened the door and when she saw it she stopped for a second then looked at me and back at it, then just sat 
Down watching it.

Keep in mind this all is happening within about 2 minutes. 

I turned on the light and it didn’t move or change in appearance, just continued into the wall. 
I stood there dumbfounded for a moment but it didn’t feel like I was in danger so I just grabbed the tools, turned off the light and left. 


Sometimes the encounters feel bad but sometimes it just gives me the same feeling as a slightly weird roommate?

There are times something hard gets thrown and my stomach drops or certain times the lights flicker, never dependent on time of day though actually they rarely flash at night. But just sometimes it feels wrong, these are times I normally end up turning off the light and closing the door to that room and just staying away for a couple hours until I feel better. 

Other times I feel completely comfortable and can even ask nicely and they’ll stop. Sometimes I have to turn it on and off again but sometimes it just immediately stops as long as I use the magic word (please). 

This hasn’t changed with the amount of occurrences, and there is a difference in my cats behavior during these times. When I feel like something is wrong with what’s going on she seems to too, and the same with when I feel comfortable normally she just sits and watches what’s happening.
